name: Gro Guardian
tagline: A small plant care companion for watering, light, and regular attention.
shortDescription: An iPhone plant care app with reminders, scheduled tasks, and a camera-based light meter.
longDescription: Gro Guardian keeps plant care practical: water, rotate, feed, and check light. It is for people who like plants but do not want another complicated tracking system.
featureHeading: Plant care as a quiet routine
featureIntro: Keep the next care task visible, use light as a guide, and let the routine stay small.

features.title: Simple Plant Dashboard
features.body: See each plant with its next useful action: water, rotate, feed, or check in.

features.title: Watering Reminders
features.body: Simple schedules and reminders for care that is easy to forget.

features.title: Live Light Meter
features.body: Use the camera to estimate light and make better placement decisions.

features.title: Scheduled Tasks
features.body: Plan care, log completions, and keep the routine light.

structuredData.description: An iPhone plant care app with reminders, scheduled tasks, and a camera-based light meter.

privacySummary: Gro Guardian uses camera access for the light meter and notifications for reminders. No ads or tracking are used.

seo.title: Gro Guardian | Simple Plant Care App
seo.description: Gro Guardian is a simple iPhone plant care app with watering reminders, a live light meter, and scheduled tasks.
